title: The Brass Bull
text: A brass bull sits over a fire in the Pit, its flanks glowing dull red, smoke curling from its nostrils. Something inside it is singing. The song is high and broken, going round and round, and it sounds almost like a prayer.

options.label: Open the brass bull, and free whatever sings inside it.

outcomes.text: A soul tumbles out, scorched and weeping. In gratitude, it blesses you with what little it has left.
A devil uncoils from inside. It is grateful in its own way, which is no way you would want.

options.label: Kick out the fire beneath it, and end the song for good.

outcomes.text: The singing stops. Something inside sighs once and never sings again.

options.label: Leave it to its song. Whoever is in there was put there for a reason.

outcomes.text: The song follows you down, round and round, a prayer without end.
